sentences.en: It is easy to consider man unique among living organisms.
sentences.zh: 很容易认为人类是所有生物中独一无二的存在。

sentences.en: Millions of beneficial organisms live in the human digestive tract.
sentences.zh: 数以百万计的有益生物体生活在人体消化道内。

sentences.en: This protein is crucial for the organism to function properly.
sentences.zh: 这种蛋白质对于有机体正常运作至关重要。

senses.zh: 有机物，有机体；生物 - 有机体系 形容词: organismal
